games.name: Return to Campus II: Billionaire Heir Goes to School
ANU: Tablets of Thoth
games.summary: ANU: Tablets of Thoth is a 3D platformer adventure where you play as Anu, a reincarnated jackal god. Sprint, scale, swim, and sail across Ancient Egypt. Use Soul Syphon to defeat undead enemies, discover hidden secrets, collect artifacts, and stop the dark sorcerer Voodoo Vulture.

games.name: I'd Choose the Bear
games.summary: Thirty days to save your late Nana's cottage in Honeywood, a lakeside town where bears and people live side by side. Date six very different bears (one of them is technically a human), outwit a resort developer, and decide who you'd really rather meet in the woods.

games.name: Note Defender: A Sight Reading Arcade
games.summary: Memorize the notes on the treble and bass staffs as well as 9 ledger lines above and below them. This covers every key of a standard 88 key piano and most instruments.

games.name: The Old Circle: Ecos da Masmorra
games.summary: A pixel-art action RPG for 1 to 4 players. Choose one of five classes, master real-time combat, shape your build with glyphs, runes and 50 gear sets, and descend through 21 dungeons with their own deadly rules to face 21 bosses, solo or in online co-op.

games.name: ABLATION
games.summary: A first person puzzle game where you carry one material at a time, and what you take from one surface, you can give to another.

games.name: Arcane Abyss
games.summary: Throw weapons onto the battlefield and build your strategy around where they land in this turn-based strategy roguelite. Read weapon accuracy, enemy movement, and elemental changes to the board, then deliver the perfect throw.

games.name: BE@RBRICK HEROES
games.summary: Run, jump, and race your way to the finish together! Create your own missions, collect a variety of BE@RBRICK, and explore a growing MMORPG world filled with adventure. Play, create, and connect your way. LET'S PLAY & CONNECT!

games.name: D.U.B.B.I.O
games.summary: Become D.U.B.B.I.O, a counter-terror AI deployed to the city of Sowrat. Juggle simultaneous hacking tasks to interfere with terrorists, gather the clues they leave behind, and deduce where they will strike and how they are armed. But this mission is only the surface of the operation.

games.name: Escape from the abandoned house haunted by spirits!!
games.summary: Kanae Yamada, a reporter for an occult magazine, visits a vast Japanese mansion abandoned for over 20 years and now notorious as a haunted location. Trapped inside, she must solve mysterious puzzles, uncover the intentions of an unseen presence, and find a way to escape.

games.name: Escape from the abandoned mansion haunted by spirits!!
Fullower
games.summary: Plant 100,456 flowers to decorate the Vegetable Boys' stage. A cozy first-person game about filling the empty terraced field around the stage with flowers, color by color.

games.name: GENNADIYYY
games.summary: A third-person comedy puzzle game about a vlogger. Gennady is trying to get through an ordinary evening: get some bread, feed his guests using whatever is in the fridge, and record a calm video.

games.name: Gliding Together
games.summary: Hang-glide from the summit to the landing field across 15 hand-crafted worlds. Lean to steer, dive for speed, thread rings to build your streak and slip past canyon walls, cable cars and laser gates. Chase your best run solo, or race up to three friends online.

games.name: hamstyping!
games.summary: Let's type together with this cute hamster! Don't squish it, okay?☆

games.name: HexWorldDefence
games.summary: A hex-tile tower defense where every unit you place becomes part of the enemy's path. Build a maze, evolve your units and hold out for 51 waves.

games.name: Iris's Idle Log
games.summary: An idle RPG for the corner of your screen. Follow Iris's long adventure, battle for equipment and resources, and grow Life Skills like Mining, Logging, Fishing, Cooking, Farming, Writing, Painting, and Commerce. Play or step away—Iris's day goes on.

games.name: Jester`s Anger
games.summary: A fast deckbuilding roguelike boomer shooter where your deck is your ammo. Hurl paint cards, playing cards and tarot spells to smash marble chess pieces to rubble, heal on their shards, and take revenge on The Hands - the giant chess player who ate the Jester's cake.

games.name: Kitchen of Gods
games.summary: Greece is starving! Build and manage your god-run tavérna along the road before Hades lures your people into the Underworld with promises of a full belly.

games.name: Koishi's Fishing Journal
games.summary: Koishi’s Fishing Journal is a Touhou Project fan-made desktop idle fishing game. Fish with Koishi, collect fish and rare merfolk, cook dishes with your catch and precious ingredients, sell them for profit, and unlock new species as Koishi enjoys her quiet fishing life on your desktop.

games.name: Koishi’s Fishing Journal - Premium Decorations Supporter Pack

games.summary: Learn Chinese from scratch with 1000 princes! Choose from Chinese courses at different levels and themed courses taught by the prince teachers, ask them questions and receive their answers. Each prince teacher shares his own story while teaching you Chinese.

games.name: NULL VECTOR
games.summary: This is a simple and challenging physics-based game. It is a remarkable achievement in track design and high score-chasing.Master different tracks, beat more and more unbelievable challenges.Tilt your device to lean your bike and touch the screen to accelerate/brake. OK,it is time to say goodbye to your free time.Features Include:* Physics-based racing.* 8 bikes and cars to choose.* Earn stars to unlock and upgrade your vehicle* More levels and new puzzles.* Amazing well designed tracks.* Simple controls and fully optimized. Addictive gameplay for you!

games.name: Pixel Sky Waystation
games.summary: On a sky island between the grassland, highland, and desert, build a place where traveling merchants can rest. Prepare lodgings and warm, steaming soup, and craft new goods from the materials they bring. As more merchants arrive, your rest stop grows into a vast trading hub for all three regions.

games.name: Planet Sweep Company
games.summary: Fun for your whole family and people of all ages!Play against your friends, or people from all over the world!Match up the pairs of cute farm animals faster than other players in a live tournament.- Use Facebook to play against your friends- Or enter a Tournament against people from all around the world.Every time you try to match up a pair you get 15 points, so the faster you play the more points you get!!ATTACK other players - Each time you match up more than one pair in a row, you attack the opposition and two of their cards shake around - destroying their concentration.The more farm animal pairs you get in a row, the more ATTACKS you play against all of the other players.Gain more points each time you win a Tournament.==== You guys can have all the fun ====

games.name: Shadows of Hollow Creek
games.summary: Uncover the truth. Survive the night. Hollow Creek is a narrative-driven psychological thriller game where investigative journalism leads Clara Pierce to an isolated town plagued by disappearances, buried secrets, and whispers of a witch. Some stories are better left untold.

games.name: Soul of Slime
games.summary: Soul of Slime is a strategic auto battler where you build your character with cards and elemental synergies. Improve your build each round, face other players’ saved builds in asynchronous PvP battles, and fight your way through all 10 rounds.

games.name: Taiikooz War
games.summary: Taiikooz War is a fast-paced, single-player zombie survival FPS. Survive hordes of the undead and plunge into a brutal where only survival matters.

games.name: Winx Club - Moonlight Quest
games.summary:
Winx Club – Moonlight Quest is a brand-new video game adventure that allows players to experience the magical universe of Winx Club through exploration, flight, action and a wide variety of mini-games.

Take control of Bloom, transform at will, explore iconic locations from the ground and the skies, master magical powers and uncover the secrets surrounding the mysterious Festival of the 100 Moons.

Alongside the main adventure, players can enjoy 32 mini-games across four game modes and play as 24 characters from the Winx Club universe.

games.name: Winx Club - Moonlight Quest: Bloom Cardix Transformation Skin
Zombie Day Protocol
games.summary: Activate beacons, summon the horde, and shoot your way out! Survive a 25-day train journey in this first-person zombie shooter. Return aboard between battles to gear up and shape your build. Fulfill a mysterious company's contract and reach the survivors' camp alive.

games.name: 39D
games.summary: 39D is a linear sci-fi horror visual novel. Once you cross the line, there’s only one way to go: down.

games.name: 52 Card Pickup
games.summary: Fifty-two decks, one very messy table. Flip, find and slot every card back into its pack across 25 gloriously messier levels, chase the fleeting Gold Cards, and call up to 3 friends to help clean up... or race them to it.

games.name: A Bad Night
games.summary: A very short horror game featuring a few choices. Experience an unusual evening with Petr, play several minigames, and find out if you will survive.

All Those Dungeons In Alva's Head
Anomaly Bird
games.summary: An anomaly-spotting game meets the bird you already know and love... or hate. See something wrong? Fly into the pipe.

games.name: Armory Chaos: Tidy Up
games.summary: Clock in as a robot and bring order to a chaotic armory. Sort weapons, pack ammo, and haul crates solo or with up to 3 friends. Use magnets and air cannons to get the job done, and watch a stray explosion turn your tidy shift into a glorious mess.

games.name: Artillery Deluxe
games.summary: A turn-based artillery duel with 40 weapons and destructible terrain. Draft your arsenal, adjust your aim, account for wind and outscore your opponent. Battle the AI, share one computer with a friend, or connect over LAN and direct online multiplayer.

games.name: Backflip Madness
games.summary: Backflip Madness is a fast-paced, parkour-flavored extreme sports game. Your goal is simple - make tons of spectacular tricks and stunts. Take it to the extreme!Features:- Multiple backflips and locations- Parkour/Free running acrobatics- Realistic physics- Achievements, Challanges and Leaderboards (Game Center)- 3 difficulty levels- Action replay- Normal and ninja outfits

games.name: Bandits are Coming
games.summary: A low-pressure tower defense where losing costs nothing but time. Place Cowboys, Dynamite, Flamers, Snipers, and Cannons across 10 levels and 20 waves each — gold and towers always carry through a retry, so you're guaranteed to win eventually. Just build, watch, and rebuild.

games.name: Barn Rush
games.summary: Pick your animal. The field is packed, the season is short, and the barn is warm. Barn Rush is a cozy time-attack collectathon roguelite where every run grows into its own weird, wonderful shape. Jump in. Every run is worth it.

games.name: Baseball (Challenge Mode Edition) - Breakthrough Gaming Arcade
BeatSlayer
games.summary: Every enemy moves on the beat. Every drop is a flood. Fly one of four ships through a three-act run, fuse two weapons into one of 1,378 fusions, take a risky deal from a talking boombox, and see how deep Endless goes once the campaign falls.

games.name: Blade Dodger
games.summary: A 2D arcade style arena survival game. As Spiff, you will sprint, dodge, and use your special abilities to stay alive long enough to make it through different levels and challenges. Features single player, 2-4 player local co-op, and 2-4 player online multiplayer.

games.name: CaTHaRSiS ~The last of atelier~
games.summary: Knowing nothing of who you are, you step into the worlds of iconic masterpieces. Walk through paintings, gather “memories,” and fill your empty vessel in this immersive art adventure. At the end of a journey through beautiful memories, what “world” will you paint?

games.name: Celeforge
games.summary: Summon and merge random heroes to create mightier heroes and fend off incoming waves of enemies! Upgrade your heroes and discover diverse relics to forge your ultimate build! It's time to conquer the Abyss!

games.name: Chess Mutator
games.summary: Chess Mutator reinvents chess with game-changing mutations, strategic AI battles, and a 40+ level campaign. Master ever-changing rules, conquer unique challenges, and continue your progress across supported platforms with one account.

games.name: Cluckin' Crash
games.summary: Cluckin’ Crash is an asymmetrical multiplayer party game where a chicken sprints through wild platform courses while a driver tries to crash, ram, and knock it off the map. Fast-paced best-of-five rounds create unpredictable physics chaos.

games.name: Come to my party!
games.summary:
Come to My Party! is a coming-of-age visual novel where choices matter. Jimin sets out to win class president and have her first birthday party.

What begins as a simple goal spirals into social pressure, fragile friendships, and choices that can’t be taken back, hitting closer than you’d like.

games.name: Commando Squad
games.summary: Lead four elite commandos behind enemy lines in 100 tactical stealth missions. Study patrols, slip past searchlights, take guards down silently and get the whole squad out alive. A classic squad-stealth tactics game, rebuilt for today.

games.name: Convoluted
games.summary: Solve the mechanisms of a mysterious machine to find the way to its core. Deduce the patterns needed to connect Glimmer to glyphs in a unique logic puzzle system inspired by mathematical convolution.

games.name: Cricket Manager 27
games.summary: Take charge of a cricket club in CM27. Manage your squad and tactics, balance the budget, scout and sign talent, develop players through the academy, and lead your side through domestic seasons and international competitions. From matchday decisions to long-term career planning.

games.name: Defender of Darkness
games.summary: An idle tower defense game: build fortifications, manage limited resources, cast spells, and decide which dark lords to save before the final battle against the forces of good. And don’t forget to raise your kraken!

games.name: Delveport
games.summary: Build a thriving fantasy harbor, recruit and equip a growing roster of heroes, and push through increasingly dangerous dungeon expeditions in this progression-focused incremental RPG.

games.name: Dicebound (Side Street Studio)
games.summary: Dicebound is a single-player dice roguelike about pushing your luck. Roll, score, and bank points before a Farkle wipes the turn. Build powerful Charm synergies, survive escalating Blinds, and chase bigger scores with every throw.

games.name: Dig (John Hunt)
games.summary: Take a contract at an abandoned mine, dig your own tunnels, sell ore, upgrade your equipment and push through five buried sectors. The deeper you go, the more you uncover about the men who worked there before you, and what they found at the bottom.

games.name: Dispatch Simulator
games.summary: Answer 911 calls with your own voice. Every caller hears what you say and answers back: panicked, confused, sometimes barely able to speak. Pull out the details that matter, find them on the map, and send police, fire, and EMS. Work the shift solo or with up to six dispatchers.

games.name: Dragon Heist
games.summary: Sneak into a castle guarded by a sleeping dragon with 3 other players, grab as much gold and treasure as you can, and flee before the dragon wakes up.

games.summary: Build your interstellar empire in Exo7! Colonize new worlds, extract Metal, Silicium, Tridioxid, and Antimatter, build mighty fleets, and explore hyperspace. Choose your faction, conquer raids and bounty hunts, and dominate Sector 7!

games.name: Fake Special Forces
games.summary: A comic-style top-down survival action game. Fight solo or in online co-op, wield multiple weapons, and modify their attacks with attachments. Move, aim, and adapt your equipment as waves of enemies close in, building a loadout that suits your playstyle.

games.name: Fathom (Morazel)
games.summary: A short horror game where you row a small boat through endless fog.

games.name: Fighting Front
games.summary: Fighting Front is a retro-inspired turn-based strategy wargame. Command your forces, capture territory, and secure resources across procedurally generated battlefields. Fight on hexagonal, triangular, or square maps against challenging AI opponents.

games.name: Fired
games.summary: FIRED is a retro-styled puzzle adventure game centered around the story of a young employee who gets FIRED while trying to expose the evil Orcus Corporation. Explore the world, solve puzzles, and work to take down Orcus.

games.name: Flying Island Miner (Two Mage Cats)
games.summary: Rise above the clouds and unearth the treasures of a floating island in this relaxing digging simulator. Dig through its layers, build a collection of curious finds, and unleash the full power of your tools. From your very first dig to the last grain of sand.

games.name: Fractured Rift: Incremental
games.summary: An incremental RPG auto-battler where you build and customize a team of allies to conquer increasingly difficult floors.

games.name: GearSpire
games.summary: Swap a part, and your deck, your robot's look, and its moves all change. Climb a tower of floating islands with a tiny pilot and a junky robot in this deckbuilding roguelike. Chain cards from different parts to build Sync, then unleash a Full Burst where every part fires its move in turn!

games.name: GeoPop
games.summary: A neon twin-stick arena shooter. Chase the x200 multiplier in Classic, build a different ship every Run from 42 upgrade cards, fly through exploding gates without firing a shot, and take on a new Daily Challenge every day.

games.name: GOBLIN ELECTRIC LTD.
games.summary: Goblin Electric Ltd. is a single-player 3D arcade-strategy roguelite. Connect pairs of living power creatures, harvest the blast, and meet contracts before the fuse burns out. Spend each megawatt on the quota, cables, skills, or relics—the faster you wire, the more spectacular the shift becomes.

games.name: Gold Idle
games.summary: Start with a single coin. Flip, upgrade, and automate your way to a fortune in an incremental game where progress uncovers more than bigger numbers. Push past familiar limits and discover things you were never meant to find.

games.name: GrassCutting
games.summary: Take a breather after an intense gaming session. Choose your mowing tool, roam varied terrain, and clear wild plants in satisfying swaths. Upgrade, collect Golden Grass, use a time-stop ability, and try different weapons on a fresh, randomly generated map each run—all at your own pace.

games.name: GrimKeep
games.summary:
The city is lost. From the castle at its center an evil spreads, changing everyone into wretched parodies of life. Desolate streets infested with monsters, perpetually dark skies threaten to spread across the land.

Be the hero, reach the GrimKeep and end the source of evil; the Princess.

In a world of fairy tales turned nightmares, GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder that challenges you to master both luck and strategy. Collect powerful relics, forge unstoppable synergies, and battle through a city consumed by darkness.

games.name: Guttering Light
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder in a vault that is running out of light. Descend four depths as one of four heroes, building a deck from cards, stones and draughts as you go. Your torch is a resource — let it gutter and experience greater pain. The lords of the vault stand between you and victory.

games.name: Hamstr Protocol
games.summary:
Hamstr Protocol is a first-person bio-mining simulator where you build, manage, and scale a mining operation powered by hamsters.

Start in a garage with a few rigs and a handful of runners. Assemble your hardware by hand, keep your hamsters fed, control the heat, and turn a small operation into an industrial-scale bio-mining business.

games.name: Haunted House Hellshift
games.summary: Fight through trap-filled rooms, blast swarms of monsters, collect eyeballs, and unlock cursed doors in a deadly haunted house game show. Make it to the exit before the house overwhelms you—solo or in local 2-player co-op.

games.name: Hidden Chess
games.summary: Every piece hides its true identity until it first moves. Play Hidden Chess, a bluffing twist on chess, against 6 levels of AI or friends and rivals online. Classic Chess is included too.

games.name: Idle Raiders: Second Run
games.summary: Idle Raiders: Second Run is an idle RPG about a band of pixel art heroes who farm, raid and loot on their own. You build their base, pick their gear, skills and AI, and send them out farming or into one of the 27 raids. Version 2.0 of the browser classic from Pit Forest, rebuilt on a new engine.

games.name: It'll Hold
games.summary: Play poker hands to build a tower of cards, one floor at a time. Each hand lays a floor piece on the plot. Stack matching suits straight up to grow your multiplier, beat every floor's target and hire a crew on your coffee break. Miss a target and the lot comes down.

games.name: Jiggle Desktop Lab 2D
games.summary: Meet your new bouncy desktop companion! Jiggle Desktop 2D brings your screen to life with satisfying, reactive physics. Poke, drag, and play with your interactive virtual pet while you work, browse, or game.

games.name: Kill to Your Heart's Content
games.summary: A clicker incremental game where every swing fuels your growth. Hold to attack, cut through monsters, and turn your earnings into lasting power. Go from struggling against a single foe to sweeping through crowds. How far will you get this time?

games.name: Kirameki Quiz: Stargazer Hill Diary
games.summary: A Japanese-language quiz game with a dating-sim twist. Spin the roulette through a 365-day campus calendar, meet 10 heroines with 5,000+ questions. NOTE: This game is in Japanese only. No English text or voice-over.

games.name: KOBALT - Das Erbe der Spiegelmacher
games.summary: Hamburg, 2027: art courier Hannes Vogt delivers a Venetian mirror and finds his client dead. To clear his name – and get his invoice paid – he follows a 340-year-old trail to Venice and beyond. A classic point-and-click adventure, fully voiced, with a dry sense of humour.

games.name: Laila's Arcane Quarry
games.summary: Mine crystals, trigger magical chain reactions, and grow a witch's workshop in this pixel-art incremental mining game. Turn short runs into lasting upgrades, craft enchanted goods, and explore nine mines with 88 research nodes and 12 crystal staffs.

games.name: Learn To Rock
games.summary: Learn To Rock – Học Cách Chơi Rock is an indie game developed by Trịnh Productions. The game is a mix of Adventure, Action, Rhythm, Simulation, and is set in Vietnam 2026. Playing as Trịnh, players will practice, overcome various challenges and recruit new members to complete his rock band.

games.name: LexiWeave
games.summary: Write words across the board, capture territory, and turn every letter into a clever move. LexiWeave is a strategic word puzzle game where careful planning, sharp vocabulary, and a little risk-taking can transform a few simple words into a sweeping victory.

games.name: Molehill Mountain
games.summary: One swing, one fistful of gold! A cartoony mole-whacking incremental game. Bonk moles before time runs out, chain combos and critical hits, then spend your gold to upgrade your hammer. Hire a Storage Keeper to stop thief moles, and defeat giant boss moles to collect relics.

games.name: Momoawase
games.summary: A cozy memory-matching game wrapped in the warmth of torn paper and colored pencils. Flip the cards, find every "Mo", and take it easy — or go for the high score.

games.name: Monolith Zero - An Incremental Odyssey Demo

games.name: Occult Pawnshop Simulator
games.summary: Run an occult pawnshop where every bargain can become a liability. Inspect strange antiques, expose forgeries, diagnose curses and serve demanding clients. Trade, cleanse and fulfil orders while yesterday's promises return as today's consequences.

games.name: Odd Express
games.summary: Discover the rules of the anomaly and survive the night. A mystery horror game set aboard a long-distance train. Explore the train and gather clues during the day, then prepare for the night. Deduce the anomaly's behavior, survive seven days, and make it to the final station.

games.name: One Gun Army
games.summary: One gun to conquer the universe. Every trigger squeeze, mag dump, and slam on the bolt release inches you closer and closer to full domination in this incremental idler.

games.name: One Million Skeletons
games.summary: Raise a skeleton army out of the dirt and throw it at a kingdom that wants its dead back. Draft the rites that shape the flood, build the graveyard into a war machine, and drag down THE KING. A reign takes about 25 minutes. Every corpse is counted, and the counting ends at one million.

games.name: ONE STEP WAR
games.summary: Want to be the best make up artist of this online world? Here is your chance! If you think you got the make up skills, take up the challenge!Look really carefully at the make up look you need to recreate, scanning the photo there, on your screen, then use those make up tools like no other! Have Fun!

games.name: Paranormal Cleaner
games.summary: Take late-night cleaning jobs in a first-person horror game. Load up your van, mop floors, vacuum rugs, and take out the rubbish. When a cupboard opens by itself or an unplugged washer starts knocking, decide how much of the checklist is worth finishing.

games.name: Parking World: Build & Manage - Crime & Concrete
Poor Samantha: An Agoraphobic Visual Novel
Pop An Old Man
games.summary: ????Awesome????Great Soundfx????Blast the Aliens and race to help the Aerospace Avengers. Your job is to collect the astronauts and shoot the aliens along the way. Collect enough astronauts and unlock more ships.

games.name: Prismhold
games.summary: A card-driven tower defense: draft towers from your deck every wave, merge three copies to evolve them without limit and mix 14 elements to survive endless waves, crowned bosses and flyers. Play solo, co-op on one map, or side by side with up to 4 players.

games.name: Project Slimechan
games.summary: Experience tentacle scenes directly in 3D on PC or in 6DOF VR.

games.name: Pulse Citadel
games.summary: Pulse Citadel is a compact sci-fi defense game where automated combat powers a hand-built research grid. Route Charge into weapons, abilities, speed, and prestige upgrades until the dormant Citadel comes fully online.

games.name: Rhythm Roll
games.summary: Roll through a world of rhythm and light in Rhythm Roll! Control a fast-moving ball through stunning levels, each with its own unique visual style and musical genre. Dodge obstacles, stay on the beat, and test your reflexes. Simple to play, but can you master the speed?

games.name: Rockhound Hollow
games.summary: Dig at 24 real rockhounding sites, crack open geodes, run a real 4-step rock tumbler and fill your Rock Journal from a cozy pixel-art cabin with Pebble the cat. A relaxing collecting game where every site, tool and fact comes from real rockhounding.

games.name: Rustlot
games.summary: Drop junked cars onto belts. Watch the shredder chew them into scrap, the magnet pull iron from copper, the smelter pour glowing ingots, and the press stamp hubcaps for cash. A cozy, tactile 2D junkyard factory game with an honest finish line — sell the lot or keep optimizing.

games.name: SAAM Tactics
games.summary: Do you have what it takes to be a Super Ambassador? Play ‘Zero to Hero’ to find out!http://www.superambassadors.org.uk-- Oes gennych y gallu i fod yn Llysgennad Gwych? Chwaraewch ‘O Ddim i Ddisglair’ i ddarganfod! http://www.llysgenhadongwych.org.uk

games.name: Sail Onward! Scion of the Sward
games.summary: A small green voyage with a long shadow. Sunlit, unhurried, and not remotely safe.

games.name: Save the Dateless Guy: Case.1 Sakura Hayase
Seat The Queen
games.summary: A strategic tug-of-war card game where four Queens decide the crown. Push, pull, protect, and disrupt your way to four thrones. Plan each round carefully, outplay your rival, and play solo, locally, or online.

games.name: Seven Nights of the Black Tide
games.summary: The classic helicopter game is back! Simply tap left or rigth to move the copter and not permit to crash. The gravity does the rest of the work.FEATURES---------------------------------• Game Center leaderboards.• Universal Binary for all iPods, iPhones, and iPads running iOS 4.3 or later.• Retina display support!• 4" display support on iPhone 5 and iPod TouchLet's go, it's very easy to play....

games.name: Shelves and Sorcery - Too Many Weapons!
Sintropia Fruits Together
games.summary: In Sintropia: Fruits Together, cooperation is the main ingredient! Control fruits with unique abilities and solve puzzles full of creativity and charm.

games.name: SKYGUARD: Last Light
games.summary: A minimalist incremental defense game. Start with one missile silo over your city, destroy screens full of threats, upgrade your firepower, and turn the Moon, the Sun, a black hole and even higher dimensions into weapons. Ten scales, ten chapters, ten doomsday ultimates.

games.name: Slime Slash VR
games.summary: A first-person VR game about cutting slimes with a sword. Clear stages, unlock guns, and take down the boss.

games.name: Sort of Paradise
games.summary: Unwind in a sunlit seaside shop. Sort of Paradise is a relaxing first-person tidying game about putting scattered beach goods back where they belong. Complete satisfying displays, earn helpful upgrades, and enjoy a little order by the ocean.

games.name: Sow the Stars
games.summary: Fire bodies into orbit, merge them, and grow a sun. When it is fully grown it goes supernova, and a new solar system is born. Systems become galaxies, and galaxies fill the universe. Aim every shot yourself, or sit back and watch it grow: a calm incremental game about building a universe.

games.name: STELLACATCH
games.summary: Catch falling stars with nothing but your cursor. Purify the Eclipses, chain FEVER with your two Star Arts, and climb to the dawn of Layer 5000. Grow your own sky through builds, constellations, observatory decor and sweets in this star-catching action game for night-sky watchers.

games.name: Super Puzzle
games.summary: A feature-packed casual jigsaw puzzle game! Enjoy multiple difficulties, real-time multiplayer battles, Workshop custom images, desktop pets, rhythm mini-games, and story mode. 9 languages, 22 Steam achievements!

games.name: Tabletop TD
games.summary: It's double trouble: cute animals must meet their match.Play all day with your new baby animal friends in this fun puzzle game. Match identical tiles to clear them from the board, Mahjong-style. Your goal is to match every single pet! Work through it carefully—you don't want to get stuck!

games.name: Take a Joke
games.summary: Family game night just got hilariously weird. Take a Joke is a fill-in-the-blank party game where everyone takes a turn being the punchline — because your names go right into the cards. Runs on your TV; everyone else plays from the phone in their pocket. 3–8 players.

games.name: Temporal Distortion
games.summary: A board game of hex pebbles at a lamplit table, on four hostile worlds. Place a pebble, turn it to strike: higher numbers take lower, and every pebble taken strikes on in a chain. No dice. Across the table, a patient stranger tells you whose story you're playing.

games.name: Terrahold
games.summary: Build an autonomous colony on a living procedural planet. Gather resources, command robots, expand your power grid, and defend the teleporter from an ecosystem that reacts to every step of your growth. Activate the link—or lose everything.

games.name: The Box Project
games.summary: A short first-person experimental game with comedy elements. You are given one simple task: supervise a box. Listen to a voice over the speakers, face a test built around attention and simple rules, and try not to prove that modern players can fail at anything.

games.name: The Hidden Index
games.summary: Investigue os recantos mais profundos da dark web neste jogo de terror psicológico e mistério. Analise arquivos, decifre terminais e desvenda segredos perturbadores numa atmosfera tensa e imersiva. Cada clique aproxima-o do desconhecido.

games.name: The Myth of Might: A Lone Wolf
The Other End
games.summary: An unexplained signal is answering you. Decode patterns, reconstruct recordings and build an understanding of an unknown intelligence in this atmospheric sci-fi puzzle adventure, with interconnected challenges and puzzle variations between playthroughs.

games.name: The Peg Mines
games.summary: The Peg Mines is a pachinko incremental game about mining for ore using a deck of crafted balls. Mine for ore, craft new balls, and manage your arsenal as you delve into the mines!

games.name: The Super Seven
games.summary: Find out the different one from the Chinese character matrix in time limit(60'). You can play even if you do not understand Chinese. It's very hard.Win or Lose? Depends on Vision.????????????????????????????????????????????????????????????

games.name: The Tally
games.summary: A PS2-style life sim about being a small, busy person in a mid-sized city. Get a job, buy a home, pet a dog, make some choices. Every one of them is being counted. You will die in about 90 minutes. Then you get the receipt, and the afterlife sorts you accordingly. A life, itemized.

games.name: TheWhisperingGodBoundGirl
games.summary: 这是一部关于爱与救赎的视觉小说。 被墟神选中的那一刻起，沈暮云就不再是人类了。 杀不死的身体、脑海中永不停歇的饥饿、随时可能失控伤及无辜的力量——这些足以压垮一个少女的东西，她独自背负了多年。 直到那个秋夜，在一条暗巷里，她遇到了那个隶属“第零部门”、嬉皮笑脸却深不可测的陆长明。 从互相戒备到彼此依靠，两个异类的生活就此交缠。然而平静之下，信徒的阴谋与墟神的苏醒正一步步逼近……

games.name: Tidy Up the Grocery Warehouse
games.summary: One partner snapped, and Ultra Fresh Food needs your help. About 3,000 products hit the floor. Restore order to the grocery warehouse with handy abilities or your own two hands, then pick and pack orders until the shelves are empty.

games.name: Toast Flipper
games.summary: Save your family as "Thoasten"! Drag, aim, and flip: In this brutally hard 2D physics platformer, you fling yourself golf-style through a dangerous kitchen, defeat evil bread bosses, and chase the ultimate best time on the global speedrun leaderboard.

games.name: Tung Tung Tung Together
games.summary: Tung Tung Tung Together is a co-op (1–4 players) survival horror set 10 years after Tung Tung Tung Survival. On the 1 km × 1 km Little Sahur Island, find items to repair your boat and escape while being hunted by the relentless Tung Tung Tung Sahur.

games.name: ULTRACRACK
games.summary: Überwinde die Schwerkraft in diesem unterhaltsamen Jump&Run-Spiel.Führe Deinen Alien durch die verschiedenen Level. Aber pass auf die Bösewichte auf, und lass Dich nichts ins Weltraum ziehen!♥ Diese App ist absolut kostenfrei

games.name: VOICE METEOR (Battle with Original Magic Born from Your Voice)
games.summary: Create spells with your voice and equip three for 5v5 battles. Mix attacks, healing, defense and disruption to support your team. Hear your own recordings become spell chants.

games.name: Whitopia
games.summary: Erase color from the world in this relaxing short painting game. Cover graffiti, clutter, and anything colorful in pure white. Earn rewards, unlock upgrades, and become more efficient as you restore a world where white is the only color allowed to exist.

games.name: Yokai Idle
games.summary: Yokai Idle is a relaxing idle RPG inspired by Japanese folklore. Collect over 50 Yokai, train skills, craft equipment with powerful modifiers, and create unique builds as you progress through the historical Ages of Japan and guide the island of Onigashima into a new era ????

games.name: yoruneko - Living Soundscape
games.summary: A living ambient workspace for focus and rest. Mix your own soundscape from layered environmental audio, set a focus timer, and watch the night sky shift with the real lunar phase. Five atmospheric moods with original music, designed by a producer for long, quiet hours of work.

games.name: Z-Defender
games.summary: Tired of the military always losing to the zombie horde? Not here. Hold your base through wave after wave, earn cash from every kill, upgrade your guns, man your posts, and call in airstrikes. Hold the line.

Hela: of Mice & Magic
games.summary:
Get ready for a cozy journey in "Hela", where you'll step into the tiny paws of a brave mouse, the beloved familiar of a witch who needs your help. 

Wander through an enchanting Scandinavian landscape filled with puzzles to solve, potions to brew, and quests to complete, all to aid your ailing witch. Whether you play alone or with friends, you're in for a treat filled with magic, companionship, and loads of charm.

"Hela" offers a delightful mix of adventure and relaxation. Enjoy exploring vast, open spaces, engaging in light-hearted play, and experiencing the simple pleasure of being a part of a caring community.

Kingdom Two Crowns: Pharaoh Lands
games.summary:
Beneath a scorching sun, a vista of rolling dunes and massive pyramid monuments rising towards the sky reveals itself. 

In Kingdom Two Crowns: Pharaoh Lands, you are setting out on a new adventure in the Valley of Kings and the domain of powerful gods in an ancient Egypt-inspired setting, only to discover the Greed now stalks the nights unleashed by foreboding chaos.

Persona 4 Revival
games.summary:
In the rural Japanese town of Inaba, the once sleepy streets receive a cold wake-up call when a mysterious serial killer strikes. Also, what's with the rumor of a mysterious TV channel appearing only on rainy nights? 

A whirlwind of surprises and otherworldly adventures will make the next year of your high school life anything but ordinary!

Persona 4 Revival intertwines an investigation into a string of murders with the journey of self-discovery and encounters with the occult, all within a critically acclaimed, classic RPG experience - reborn in a new form!
